title: The FDA-Approved Antibiotic That Caused Sudden Death in 1 in 500 Kids
hook: Parents gave their children a common antibiotic for ear infections—and within hours, some were dead from cardiac arrest.
why_this_can_go_viral: Targets parental fear directly—every parent wants to know if their child's medicine is safe.

title: The Suppressed Cure: $0.50 Ginger Tea Stopped 60% of Chemo Nausea—But Pharma Buried It
hook: A simple root was shown in three clinical trials to outperform anti-nausea drugs—then funding for the studies mysteriously vanished.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into outrage over profit-driven medicine—cheap solutions buried for corporate greed always spark shares.

title: The Toxic Deodorant That Caused 1 in 20 Women to Develop Breast Cancer
hook: For decades, a chemical in antiperspirants was linked to tumors—until a whistleblower forced the formula to change.
why_this_can_go_viral: Personal care products affect everyone—women especially will share this as a warning to friends.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How 'Gluten Sensitivity' Was Invented to Sell $10 Billion in Products
hook: A small study with 20 participants created a medical condition that never existed—and now 1 in 5 people believe they have it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Debunking a widespread belief creates cognitive dissonance—viewers love 'you've been lied to' content.

title: The Doctor Who Cured 100 Terminal Patients—Then Was Arrested for 'Practicing Without a License'
hook: He had a 90% remission rate for stage 4 cancer patients—but the medical board shut him down and threw him in prison.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'hero doctor punished by system' narrative is emotionally explosive—outrage drives shares.

title: The Hospital That Sold Cancer Patients' DNA to Insurance Companies Without Consent
hook: Biopsies taken for diagnosis were secretly analyzed and sold—patients later found their life insurance canceled for 'genetic risks'.
why_this_can_go_viral: Privacy violation fears are universal—viewers will share to warn others about what hospitals do with their data.

title: The Suppressed Cure: $1 Castor Oil Pack Healed 70% of Liver Cysts—Then Doctors Called It 'Pseudoscience'
hook: Traditional medicine used this for centuries—until a 2005 study confirmed its effectiveness and was immediately retracted.
why_this_can_go_viral: Cheap, accessible cure suppressed by big medicine—outrage and hope combine for high engagement.

title: The Toxic Baby Shampoo That Caused 1 in 15 Infants to Develop Kidney Stones
hook: A gentle 'no tears' formula was laced with a chemical that crystallized inside babies' kidneys—and stayed on shelves for 5 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Parents are the most protective audience—any threat to babies triggers immediate, emotional sharing.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How 'ADHD' Was Created by Food Dyes—But Pharma Hid the Link
hook: A 1975 study showed that removing artificial colors from kids' diets eliminated 70% of ADHD symptoms—so the funding was cut.
why_this_can_go_viral: Parents of children with ADHD will immediately watch and share—diet-based solutions are always a hot topic.

title: The Doctor Who Performed Unnecessary Heart Surgeries on 300 Children for Profit
hook: He told parents their kids had rare defects—then opened their chests and stitched them back up, charging insurance for the 'procedure'.
why_this_can_go_viral: Betrayal of vulnerable children by a trusted doctor is the ultimate dark story—extreme reactions guaranteed.

title: The FDA-Approved Contraceptive That Caused 1 in 30 Users to Have Strokes
hook: Million of women were prescribed 'the safest birth control pill'—then a study found it quadrupled stroke risk in young women.
why_this_can_go_viral: Massive female audience—birth control users will urgently share to warn friends and family.

title: The Hospital That Forced 400 Mental Health Patients to Work in a Factory for Free
hook: Patients were declared 'therapeutically employed'—but the hospital pocketed millions from their labor while they slept in cages.
why_this_can_go_viral: Slavery disguised as therapy is a shocking revelation—historical injustice stories perform extremely well.

title: The Suppressed Cure: $3 Epsom Salt Baths Reduced 50% of Asthma Attacks—Doctors Laughed
hook: A 2012 study showed magnesium absorbed through the skin relaxed airways—but pharmaceutical reps mocked it as 'bath water magic'.
why_this_can_go_viral: Asthmatics and parents of asthmatic children will watch—cheap alternatives to expensive inhalers always attract attention.

title: The Pharmaceutical Company That Sold a Vaccine That Caused 1 in 100 Kids to Develop Narcolepsy
hook: A swine flu vaccine was rushed to market—thousands of children suddenly fell asleep uncontrollably, and the company hid the data for years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Vaccine safety is a polarizing topic—this factual case will be shared by both sides of the debate.

title: The Experiment That Kept 25 Elderly Patients in a Cold Room to 'Test Hypothermia Tolerance'
hook: Nursing home residents were locked in a 40°F room for 72 hours—13 died, and the researchers called it 'acceptable losses'.
why_this_can_go_viral: Elder abuse combined with cold scientific cruelty—visceral anger and sadness drive massive sharing.

title: The Toxic Sunscreen That Caused 1 in 20 Users to Develop Melanoma—Not Prevent It
hook: A popular sunscreen brand actually absorbed UV rays and converted them into cancer-causing free radicals on the skin.
why_this_can_go_viral: Summer season relevance—sunscreen is used by billions, and the irony of it causing cancer is highly shareable.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How the 'Peanut Allergy Epidemic' Was Triggered by a Single Product
hook: A popular baby lotion contained peanut oil that sensitized infants through broken skin—cases exploded 300% in a decade.
why_this_can_go_viral: Parents terrified of peanut allergies will watch—finding a specific cause is deeply satisfying and shareable.

title: The Doctor Who Performed 500 Unnecessary C-Sections to Collect 'Weekend Delivery' Fees
hook: Pregnant women were told emergencies required immediate surgery—but the doctor was just trying to hit his golf tee time on Saturday.
why_this_can_go_viral: Pregnancy is a universal experience—every mother will be outraged and share this cautionary tale.
